Chapter 1126: 41: The Importance Of Lin Yuan (Request Subscription)_2

Chapter 1126: Chapter 41: The Importance of Lin Yuan (Request Subscription)_2

But Lin Yuan is different.

Though part of the royal family, and a core member at that, if Lin Yuan wishes to join the royal bloodline, his status and treatment will far surpass those who have pledged allegiance as Heavenly Venerates.

“Alright, I am willing to join.”

Lin Yuan did not hesitate, nodded and said.

At present, the benefits of joining the ancient country’s royal family far outweigh the disadvantages.

The only hidden danger is that Lin Yuan does not truly possess the core royal bloodline.

However, since blending and consuming the ‘Fierce Sun’s Source’ within his internal cosmos, Fierce Sun’s radiance has spread from the internal cosmos throughout his body, naturally absorbing the radiance emitted by the eternal Fierce Sun in the external world.

The Fierce Sun bloodline within Lin Yuan is also rapidly becoming purer, now almost reaching the standard of a normal royal bloodline.

After a period of time, transforming to the core royal bloodline concentration is estimated to be not difficult.

The Divine Skill ‘Fierce Sun Opening the Sky’ is essentially the innate method of the Ancestor of Fierce Sun, constantly operating this divine skill can autonomously purify the Fierce Sun bloodline within.

Of course, this bloodline transformation and purification only have an effect in this source world.

As for the Primordial Spirit in the Chaos Void, it is useless.

Firstly, the Primordial Spirit in the Chaos Void does not possess the Fierce Sun bloodline.

The so-called purification of the bloodline requires the existence of said bloodline.

Secondly, the Chaos Void does not have the eternal Fierce Sun above the source world’s sky.

Lin Yuan can feel that the purification and refinement of the Fierce Sun bloodline within mainly come from being enveloped by the eternal Fierce Sun’s radiance above the sky.

“Good! Good!”

King Chibao couldn’t help but smile upon hearing Lin Yuan’s agreement, “With your joining, Galaxy, in the future our royal family lineage can really let off some steam.”

“Let off steam?”

Lin Yuan looked at King Chibao.

“Galaxy hasn’t interacted with the royal family before, it’s normal not to know.” King Chibao explained: “Within the Fierce Sun Ancient Country, competition is very intense.”

“Mainly the royal families competing with those Heavenly Venerates.”

“The most precious resources are limited, the royal family wants them, and the Heavenly Venerates want them too.”

“Although the Heavenly Venerates’ ancestor bloodline is not dense, their strength is great, and their voice in the capital is not low.”

“If not for the fact that every emperor of the ancient country must possess the royal bloodline, I fear our royal family would be suppressed by those Heavenly Venerates.”

King Chibao sighed.

This matter is difficult to manage, belonging to the internal affairs of the Fierce Sun Ancient Country, as most Heavenly Venerates also have the blood of the Ancestor of Fierce Sun flowing within them, though somewhat diluted, they are considered ancestor descendants.

If it were external enemies invading, the ancestor could be asked to sweep them away, but competition between the same bloodlines? The ancestor is reluctant to intervene.

“I see.”

Lin Yuan’s expression became clear.

He had heard early on that the Heavenly Venerates looked down on the ancient country royal family.

This disdain likely isn’t purely disdain but also involves conflicts of interest.

The great power of the ancient country is mostly in the hands of the emperor, and as emperors, they will certainly favor their kin, but cannot be too biased. If they anger those Heavenly Venerates, it’s not easy to handle.

For instance, if in the wars between ancient countries, they collectively hold back, it would be very troublesome.

Therefore, every emperor of the ancient country tries to maintain a certain fairness between the royal family and the Heavenly Venerates for the greater picture.

Of course, the most core inheritance and resources of the ancient country are only eligible for the royal family to compete over, which is the biggest advantage of being part of the royal family.

This is precisely why the Heavenly Venerates look down on the royal family.

“But, with your talent, Galaxy, once you join the royal bloodline, touching upon our true royal inheritance and resources will surely advance you rapidly, perhaps breaking the Heavenly Venerates’ shackles in the future.”

King Chibao looked at Lin Yuan with anticipation.

The so-called Heavenly Venerates’ shackle is the iron law that the royal family cannot step into being a Heavenly Venerate.

No ancient country royal member has crossed into being a Heavenly Venerate so far.

This is the ongoing reason for the continuous struggle between the royal family and the Heavenly Venerates within the ancient country.

In terms of strength, excluding the emperor and a handful of royal members with ancient country foundation, the strength of the Heavenly Venerates side overwhelms the royal side.

If a Heavenly Venerate were to emerge from the royal side, the situation between the two would be completely rewritten.

“I’ll do my best.”

Lin Yuan nodded.

“Doing your best is enough.”

King Chibao grinned, holding great expectations for Lin Yuan.

Without having been trained by the royal family, reaching this level, once exposed, what would it be like?

Any strong beings, whether royal blooded or Heavenly Venerates who joined later, experience a period of rapid advancement when first exposed to royal inheritance resources.

…

King Chibao introduced various internal matters of the royal family to Lin Yuan in detail, then curiously asked: “Chijue showed me the footage of Galaxy’s fight with King Lingshen.”

“Since Galaxy brother could kill King Lingshen, you must have progressed far in breaking the Heavenly Venerates’ shackle.”

“Could we spar a bit, so I can witness it?”

King Chibao looked at Lin Yuan with anticipation.

He wasn’t doubting Lin Yuan’s strength, many had seen the matter of killing King Lingshen, it couldn’t be faked.

King Lingshen, as a core royal family of Da Ling Ancient Country, wouldn’t be acting to court Lin Yuan.

King Chibao was simply curious about Lin Yuan’s strength, since he had grown to the limits of the core royal family, knowing the difficulty of progressing further at this level.

“No problem.”

Lin Yuan nodded.

He was also curious to see the methods of the core royal family of Fierce Sun Ancient Country who had reached their limits.

While King Lingshen was extreme core royal family, he belonged to Da Ling Ancient Country, and the core royal family’s methods could vary between ancient countries.

“Good, let’s go to a higher realm space.”

King Chibao immediately stood up.

Soon.

The two reached a higher realm space.

Here, the area is vast, even the aftermath of Heavenly Venerates’ combat, descending onto the ground, would significantly diminish.

“Galaxy, I’ll make a move.”

Red Pine King’s form began to blur, vaguely hinting, as if a great sun condensed.

Lin Yuan’s mind slightly moved, the Fierce Sun Divine Body automatically activated, forming a vast Fierce Sun world.

Rumble.

Red Pine King also began to activate the Fierce Sun Divine Body, similarly forming a Fierce Sun world, and the two worlds kept colliding and sparring.

The Fierce Sun Divine Body is the strongest physique of Fierce Sun Ancient Country, every awakened member possesses unique Fierce Sun Divine Bodies, but in general aspects, they are similar.

For example, the Fierce Sun worlds formed by the automatic operation of the Divine Body are abilities that every Fierce Sun Divine Body possessor has.

The strength of the Fierce Sun world is related to the foundation of the Fierce Sun Divine Body.

Boom! Boom! Boom!

The two colossal Fierce Sun worlds kept colliding, and it was evident that the Fierce Sun world formed by Lin Yuan was stronger.

“Hmm?”

Lin Yuan looked at the serious expression of Red Pine King, slightly enhancing the strength of the Fierce Sun world.

The strength of the Fierce Sun world depends on the foundation of the Fierce Sun Divine Body, and also on the foundation of each strong being.

The foundation is the base, Lin Yuan’s internal cosmos has fused and swallowed the Fierce Sun’s Source, his foundation is unprecedentedly strong, not just the Fierce Sun world, even the simplest punch can unleash earth-shattering power.

The “Infinite Void” inheritance enhances Lin Yuan’s all-round abilities, rather than limiting to just one.

“Not good.”

King Chibao’s expression slightly changed, he could clearly feel the pressure increase from Lin Yuan’s Fierce Sun world, his own Fierce Sun world beginning to distort under the opponent’s oppression.

“What kind of foundation is necessary to make the Fierce Sun world so powerful?” King Chibao was shocked inside.

Originally, he thought whether Lin Yuan used certain one-time methods to easily kill King Lingshen.

But now, through the collision of their Fierce Sun worlds, he no longer had this idea.

The collision between Fierce Sun worlds is entirely a contest between both sides’ foundations, without any tricks.

After all, the Fierce Sun world originates from the Fierce Sun Divine Body, and the Divine Body stems from oneself, external forces can enhance attack and defense but cannot directly enhance the Fierce Sun Divine Body.

“I concede, Galaxy.”

King Chibao persisted for a while, but in the end was unable to endure, if continued, he would have to resort to killing means, contradicting the sparring.

Thus King Chibao spoke without hesitation:

“I concede.”
